candidates.reason: The PR fixes get_func_args_dict() in scrapy/utils/python.py, which compared parameter names against a functools.partial's positional values and therefore dropped the wrong arguments (get_func_args(partial(f, "b")) returned [] instead of ["b"]). This is the only test module that exercises get_func_args/get_func_args_dict, including the partial and stripself cases that guard the regression.

The PR changes scrapy/utils/ssl.py: ffi_buf_to_string() recursed into itself instead of calling _ffi_buf_to_string(), and requiring pyOpenSSL >= 24.3.0 lets the X.509 and temp-key branches be simplified. scrapy/utils/ssl.py has no dedicated test module today, so this is the natural location for the deprecation-path and version-gated coverage added by the PR.

This is the only test module that imports scrapy.utils._compression. The PR fixes _inflate() so it no longer loops forever on a deflate body followed by extra bytes; those decompression paths are exercised through the HttpCompressionMiddleware tests here (and via the imported _DecompressionMaxSizeExceeded max-size behavior).

The PR is a test-coverage improvement for scrapy.utils and its first bullet is a bug fix inside scrapy/utils/_compression.py (_inflate infinite loop on raw deflate plus trailing bytes). That module has no dedicated unit test file in the current tree, so direct unit coverage of _inflate and the max-size checks would be added in a utils-level test module mirroring the source file name.
